target_customer: Couples in the US who share expenses and want joint banking and savings
problem: Couples struggle to manage shared money with accounts built for individuals. Ivella started as an expense splitting app and moved to joint checking and savings.
business_model: Consumer fintech through partner bank, earning interchange and balances revenue (inferred from banking as a service category; not stated in sources)

founders.name: Kahlil Lalji
founders.background_notes: Now CEO of Natural per the YC page.

founders.name: Vishal Dubey
founders.background_notes: Product engineering at EarnIn and built joint banking products at Ivella per YC page.

founders.name: Eric Wang
founders.background_notes: Now building payments infrastructure for AI agents at Natural per YC page.

exit.reason: Company site says products were sunset and the team joined EarnIn to continue building; no date or deal terms stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on a banking as a service partner, so mostly app engineering, with compliance, KYC and joint account logic adding difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Joint accounts sit on partner bank rails that rivals can use, and couples banking niche players such as Tandem and Onward offered similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in the sources found; the team joined EarnIn when products were sunset.

market_need_then: Couples sharing money used workarounds such as one partner paying and Venmo; TechCrunch covered it in 2022 as the latest couples banking fintech, showing crowded interest.

branding.domain_note: Used ivella.com; trademark IVELLA filed May 2022 and registered June 2023 per a trademark record.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and relationship focused: products for couples at any stage.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches in April 2022 and May 2023; no merch or fan content found.

brand_strength.rationale: A soft invented name with a registered mark, but no press on the brand and easily confused with Ivory Ella and other Ivella entities.

pivots.to: Joint checking and savings accounts with savings pods
pivots.why: Press release said joint accounts, credit and investing were planned; the product moved to joint accounts by Product Hunt launch in May 2023

outcome_analysis: Ivella raised a 3.5M seed in June 2022 for couples banking and launched joint accounts in 2023, then sunset its products and joined EarnIn. The company page does not give a reason, date or deal terms, and no post-mortem was found. The failure factors are therefore tentative: a soft landing is stated by the site, while a missing next round is only inferred from the absence of later funding.
notes: Cause of shutdown beyond the site statement is not public. Seed seen in a law firm press release and TechCrunch coverage. A pre-seed of about 480K in June 2021 appears only on an aggregator, so it is not recorded as a round; totals range 3.5M to 4.5M by aggregator. YC page lists Los Angeles, CB Insights lists Santa Monica. CB Insights names Tandem, Zeta, Onward, Smoov and Yunite as competitors but the page is undated, so the dated list is empty; Smoov was founded in 2021 per that page. Product Hunt launch dates April 2022 and May 2023 come from aggregator pages. Exit type shutdown matches Inactive status although the team joined EarnIn.
